overall_goal: Measure the correct amount of risotto rice

goals.description: Prepare the rice and bowl for measuring
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the jar of rice, checks the recipe, opens the jar, and positions the bowl to get ready for measuring.

goals.description: Pour and adjust the amount of rice
goals.rationale: The person pours rice into the bowl, then retrieves a spoon to remove excess rice and return it to the jar to get the exact measurement.
